scope: Educational prototype. Local paths inspected; main links are publishing targets, not a claim of remote availability.

mobile.name: Flutter Mobile App
mobile.responsibility: Starts a MaterialApp and displays MapScreen. Authentication and API helpers exist but are not wired to this screen.

identity.name: Keycloak Authentication
identity.responsibility: Defines the integradora realm and public flutter-mobile client with S256 PKCE. Backend code validates JWT signature, expiry, issuer, audience and authorized client. Login UI and callback handling remain exercises.

rest.name: FastAPI REST API
rest.responsibility: Registers public /health and protected /locations routes. Locations returns a fixed Mexico City fixture; no database queries are implemented.

relational.name: PostgreSQL
relational.responsibility: Creates a SQLAlchemy engine from POSTGRES_URL and a session dependency. Intended relational persistence; no tables or queries yet.

documents.name: MongoDB
documents.responsibility: Creates a Motor client from MONGODB_URL and selects MONGODB_DATABASE. Intended document persistence; no queries yet.

maps.name: Leaflet / Maps Service
maps.responsibility: Displays an interactive map, static marker and attribution using OpenStreetMap tiles. The implemented Flutter package is flutter_map, not Leaflet.

compose.name: Docker Compose
compose.responsibility: Defines api, postgres, mongodb and keycloak, development environment variables, local port bindings, realm import and database volumes.

containers.name: Docker
containers.responsibility: Builds the API image, installs declared Python requirements during a future build, and launches app.main:app with Uvicorn.

localgit.name: Git
localgit.responsibility: Version-controls the educational prototype folder. This link targets the user-specified main publishing branch; local files are currently untracked.

remotehub.name: GitHub
remotehub.responsibility: Hosts the repository and its source history. External source-control trust domain; publication is separate from local generation.
